title: London- and Boston-based Mindgard, which offers automated AI security and red-teaming tools to help organizations secure AI systems, raised a $30M Series A (Ionut Arghire/SecurityWeek)
summary: Ionut Arghire / SecurityWeek: London- and Boston-based Mindgard, which offers automated AI security and red-teaming tools to help organizations secure AI systems, raised a $30M Series A — The cybersecurity startup will use the fresh investment to scale its product, engineering, sales, and marketing teams.
